div.head: Grið 22
div.ab: ⁊ hwilum wearð geworden, swa swa God wolde, sceaphyrde to cynge ⁊ se wearð swyþe mære; eac wearð geworden, swa swa God wolde, fiscere to biscope ⁊ se wæs swyþe dyre ⁊ Christe gecweme.
And hwilum wearð geworden, swa swa God wolde, sceaphyrde to cynge and se wearð swyþe mære; eac wearð geworden, swa swa God wolde, fiscere to biscope, and se wæs swyþe dyre and Christe gecweme.

Und einstmals war, wie Gott wollte, ein Schafhirt [David] zum König geworden, und dieser wurde sehr ruhmreich; auch war, wie Gott wollte, ein Fischer [Petrus] zum Bischof geworden und der war Christo sehr theuer und wohlgefällig.
And once, as God willed, a shepherd [David] became king, and he became very glorious; also, as God willed, a fisherman [Peter] became bishop, and he was very dear and pleasing to Christ.

And it once came to pass, just as God decreed, that a shepherd became a king and he was exceedingly great; it also came to pass, just as God decreed, a fisherman became a bishop, and he was greatly beloved and pleasing to Christ.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
